consumer: A dialogue/condition possession check (conditional_t::set_has_item) that asks yes/no: does the character personally carry the detonator on their body?
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded weapon + worn + personal inventory), not nearby/reachable items
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item — its body evaluates actor->charges_of(item_id)>0 || actor->has_amount(item_id,1) on the character actor, an on-person possession predicate whose returned bool the engine condition consumes
divergence: The detonator sits in an adjacent crate within crafting reach but is not worn/wielded/in inventory: a crafting_inventory()-scoped check (mission.cpp MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) returns true, while the correct on-person possession check returns false
